basic_profile.bio: I’m a 23-year-old college student living in Austin, Texas. I’m currently majoring in psychology, which fuels my interest in altered states of consciousness. I’m single and enjoy experimenting with safe recreational substances as a hobby. I’m usually online in the evenings after classes and tend to stay up late, especially on weekends. In my free time, I like gaming and exploring new music genres.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My interest in recreational substances comes from a combination of self-study and peer influence. I’ve read a lot of online resources and forums about different substances and their effects. My psychology coursework also provides some insight into how substances might affect the brain.
